messages:
Liam (acct exec): Nightingale Credit just emailed procurement asking for ISO 27001 scope statement, latest SOC2 Type II, a named pen-test attestation, subprocessor list, and confirmation we won’t bump data to a different region during the POC. They need it before the contract review next Tue.
Priya (solutions): Big ask. ISO scope we can provide the scope doc (app + infra) but we don’t have an ISO cert in-house. We usually provide the scope statement and controls mapping.
Jules (security): I can pull the SOC2 Type II PDF and controls mapping. Subprocessor list is the tricky one — we can share a redacted list of third parties we use, per policy.
Ana (legal): Holding: we need to confirm the subprocessor disclosure level. Procurement sometimes wants full list; we usually provide authorized subprocessors and contact info for verification. Also, named pen-test attestation — legal can sign a letter if we have vendor summary.
Marco (eng): Region change during POC is a deployment request. We can guarantee region pinning for the POC environment for the length of the trial (30 days) if ops approves. That should satisfy their "no region bump" ask.
Liam (acct exec): They're also asking if we'd sign a SOC2 "bridge" letter to cover interim months between last report and now. Is that allowed?
Jules (security): We don't issue bridge letters. We can provide the latest SOC2 report, a controls update note (what's changed since report), and a risk statement. That usually satisfies security teams.
Ana (legal): Confirmed: no bridge letters. We can provide a factual controls update memo on letterhead, but avoid language implying attestation.
Priya (solutions): Checklist and owners: 
- SOC2 Type II PDF (Jules)
- Controls update memo (Jules + Ana)
- Subprocessor list (redacted) (Jules + Ana)
- Pen-test vendor summary (Jules)
- Pen-test attestation letter draft (Ana)
- Region pin confirmation for POC (Marco)
- Share package via expiring link and note in CRM (Liam)

Timeline?
Liam (acct exec): They want everything by Monday COB to hit their Tuesday legal review. Tight but possible.
Jules (security): I can export SOC2 + controls update by Friday EOD. Pen-test vendor summary by Monday 10:00 local. Subprocessor list redacted Friday.
Marco (eng): I'll confirm the ops region pin by Friday 15:00 and provide the ZT policy excerpt.
Ana (legal): I'll draft the pen-test attestation letter template tonight; can sign Monday AM if vendor summary arrives. Will need recipient name (Nightingale Credit, Attn: Procurement).
Liam (acct exec): Recipient: procurement@nightingalecredit.com, Attn: Maria Chen (procurement).
Priya (solutions): A heads-up: procurement asked whether providing these docs moves the POC to paid or changes SOW. I told them the POC remains the standard trial, but any custom engineering (region pinning beyond default) may be scoped separately.
Ana (legal): Language for the pen-test attestation: factual date and scope only. No forward-looking guarantees. I'll include: "This attestation is provided solely to Nightingale Credit in connection with their evaluation of Redwood Inference."
Jules (security): Also adding vendor contact details for verification in the pen-test summary. Vendor performed app+infra pentest Q4-2024, no critical findings, two highs (both remediated), list of CVEs and PRs attached.
Marco (eng): I will attach PRs #941 and #947 with deploy timestamps and a short remediation verification checklist.
share-bot: Created folder: https://drive.redwood.com/nightingale-poc-docs (expires 6 days).
Liam (acct exec): I'll send a short note to Maria Chen: "We can provide SOC2, ISO scope, subprocessor list (redacted), and a pen-test attestation. Target delivery: Mon COB. Please confirm if that timeline works for legal review"
Priya (solutions): Also propose to add an item in the SOW: "Artifact versions provided with date and package link; subsequent requests will be handled as change orders." Keeps future asks clearer.
Ana (legal): Agreed. Add the clause and I'll approve wording.
Jules (security): Uploading SOC2, controls memo, and subprocessor list to the draft folder now.
Marco (eng): POC region pin confirmed for eu-west-1 for the trial window. I'll include ops ticket ID for audit.
Liam (acct exec): Sending the initial message to procurement now. Will update thread with any reply. :rocket:
Priya (solutions): Thanks team. If procurement asks for a demo of remediation evidence, I can run a short tech call during the review window.
Ana (legal): One more legal note: do not share vendor raw reports unless vendor has allowed distribution. Share vendor summary only unless we have NDA allowing full report.
Jules (security): Confirmed. We have permission to share vendor summary, not the raw report.
Liam (acct exec): Sweet, will follow up. Closing loop when docs are uploaded and link is in CRM.
